description: Master registry of all Silver Layer domain frameworks. Each entry points to a domain_silver_domain.json file containing the canonical slv_* entity skeleton for that subject area.

domains.name: campaign
domains.summary: Canonical silver spine for campaign data: impressions → clicks → conversions → performance. Covers Google Ads, Meta, DV360, and email platform sources.

domains.name: sales
domains.summary: Canonical silver spine for sales data: customer → product → order → order line → performance. Covers CRM, ERP, and sell-through data.

domains.name: loyalty
domains.summary: Canonical silver spine for loyalty data: member → tier → enrolment → transaction → redemption → performance. Covers points earn, burn, and churn.

domains.name: trade_promotions
domains.summary: Canonical silver spine for trade promotion data: promotion → retailer → product → spend → uplift → ROI. Covers TPM systems and sell-out data.

domains.name: pricing
domains.summary: Canonical silver spine for pricing data: product → zone → price list → price point → price change → competitor price → performance.

domains.name: digital_commerce
domains.summary: Canonical silver spine for e-commerce data: visitor → session → product view → cart → purchase → performance. Covers GA4, Adobe Analytics, and Shopify.

amber_domains.name: supply_chain
amber_domains.summary: Supply Chain spans multiple domains. Framework coming soon — scope to consumer or product impact before proceeding.

amber_domains.name: finance
amber_domains.summary: Finance data is broad in scope. Framework coming soon — link to a specific product line or consumer segment.
